Chapter 452 - 452 Drink It; Command!

Chapter 452 - 452 Drink It; Command!

452 Drink It; Command!

In Ye Xiu’s heart, Lin Fan was the direct descendant of the Qing Hong Sect’s patriarch and the current sect master of the Qing Hong Sect. He had supreme status!

How could others casually barge into the room he was staying in and disturb him?

Lin Fan waved his hand and said, “It’s fine.”

As he spoke, he spent ten million yuan to exchange for a bottle of Medical Water from the system.

Then, he handed it to Ye Xiu and said, “Drink this.”

Even though Lin Fan and Ye Xiu had only interacted for a short while, Lin Fan already had a good impression of him.

Therefore, he was willing to help him.

Ye Feng, who was standing at the side, looked at the unknown liquid in Lin Fan’s hand, and his eyes narrowed.

Drink it?

What kind of status did Ye Xiu have?

Whether it was his food or drinks, they had to go through strict checks.

What if it was poisonous?

Moreover…

Ye Xiu’s body was in a terrible state.

Even if it was not poison, he could not consume anything so casually.

His body would not be able to withstand it if anything went wrong.

“Old Master, you…”

However, before Ye Feng could finish speaking, Ye Xiu swept him with a cold gaze. He was so frightened that he did not dare to speak.

Ye Xiu did not hesitate and poured the Medical Water into his mouth.

He did not believe that Lin Fan would poison him.

Even if it was poison, so what?

If the sect master wanted to kill him, he had no choice but to die!

Under the watchful eyes of Ye Feng and the people from the four great families, Ye Xiu slowly swallowed the medicine.

In the next moment…

Ye Xiu was stunned.

At first, he felt pain all over his body and was extremely uncomfortable.

As the liquid entered his stomach, he felt a sense of relaxation and comfort that he had not felt for a long time.

This feeling…

It was like a rusty machine that had been refilled with grease!

At this moment, Ye Xiu even had the illusion that all the pain in his body had disappeared!

Disappeared?

How was this possible?

One had to know…

He was suffering from many incurable diseases that could not be treated at all!

Ye Feng, who was standing behind him, saw that the old man was standing still after drinking the unknown liquid. He immediately had a bad feeling.

“Old Master, are you alright?”

Then, he shouted at Lin Fan, “What did you give the old master?!”

When Ye Xiu heard this, he came back to his senses.

“Bastard!” he shouted sternly. “Who gave you the guts to shout at the sect master like this?!”

Ye Xiu’s voice was no longer as weak as before.

Instead, it was full of energy and was very loud!

Then, he picked up the dragon-headed cane in his hand and fiercely smacked Ye Feng.

It was extremely powerful!

Ye Feng was careless and even fell to the ground.

Seeing that Ye Xiu was fine, he heaved a sigh of relief.

Then, he said in a very flustered tone. “I’m sorry, I lost my manners.”

“You lost your manners? You offended your superior, you bastard!” Ye Xiu shouted angrily. He picked up the cane again and ruthlessly smacked Ye Feng.

This time, Ye Xiu was truly furious.

On one hand…

Just as he had said, it was an act of defiance!

On the other hand…

He could clearly feel that his body had recovered.

A bottle of medicine had healed his body.

He knew very well how precious this bottle of medicine was.

In the end, his savior was suspected by Ye Feng. He was simply a bastard!

At this moment, Lin Fan said, “Alright, there’s no need to hit him. He was just worried about you. However, I don’t want it to happen again.”

“Yes.”

Then, Elder Ye turned to Ye Feng and shouted, “Hurry up and thank the sect master!”

Ye Feng, who was lying on the ground, endured the pain in his body and said, “Thank you, Sect Master.”

Ye Xiu ignored Ye Feng. He sighed and said, “Sect Master, you gave me such precious medicinal liquid that made all the illnesses in my body disappear without a trace… I… I’m really ashamed!”

His words were not pretentious at all.

He was very sincere.

This was because Ye Xiu understood that a treasure like the Medical Water, which could be considered a godly medicine, was extremely rare and precious.

Otherwise, Lin Fan would not have carried it with him all the time.

In the end, he gave it to him.

If something happened to Lin Fan’s body in the future, what would he do?

Ye Xiu was an old man who was over a hundred years old. He had one leg in the grave. He couldn’t compare to Lin Fan at all.

Ye Feng, who was crawling on the ground, was slightly stunned when he heard this.

What did Elder Ye just say?

All his illnesses had disappeared without a trace?

Yes!

Elder Ye’s voice seemed to be very loud and clear.

In addition, when he hit him just now, he was also very powerful.

Elder Ye had really gotten better!

Thinking up to this point, Ye Feng’s face was filled with smiles. The way he looked at Lin Fan was filled with respect and admiration.

Lin Fan could tell that Ye Xiu’s words came from the bottom of his heart. He nodded his head and said, “What I gave you was Medical Water. It’s nothing to me.”

When Ye Xiu heard this, he heaved a sigh of relief.

At this moment, Qin Yuxuan, who was standing at the side, suddenly said in surprise, “You’re Mr. Chen, Mr. Wang, Mr. Huang, and Mr. Zhao!”

Currently, Fan Yu Investment was one of the top investment companies in Modu.

As the chairwoman of Fan Yu Investment, Qin Yuxuan was obviously more knowledgeable than Zhang Ting.

Earlier, she had panicked because Ye Xiu had coughed up blood.

Qin Yuxuan finally regained her senses and looked around.

With one look…

She realized that among the people who had just barged in, there were actually people from the four great families of Modu. They were even the patriarchs of the four great families!

Any one of the patriarchs of the four great families could cause the entire city to shake with just a stomp of their feet.

Now, they were actually gathered together!

Moreover, they had appeared in front of her!

No wonder Qin Yuxuan was so surprised.

When the four leaders heard Qin Yuxuan’s words, they were so frightened that their bodies trembled.

One had to know…

Qin Yuxuan was Lin Fan’s girlfriend. How could they be worthy of her comment?

Even Elder Ye was so respectful in front of Lin Fan.

“You can just call me Lil Wang.”

“Just call me Lil Chen.”

“Just call me Lil Huang.”

“Just call me Lil Zhao.”

Qin Yuxuan was stunned.

Lin Fan smiled and said, “Yuxuan, they booked the entire theme park for us yesterday. Also, if you have any problems in Modu, you can ask them for help.”

“You can command us at any time.”

“Just treat us as your subordinates.”

“Yes, yes!”

…

When Qin Yuxuan heard the words of the four leaders, she was stunned again.

Commanding them at will and treating them as subordinates?

This…
